title: Readable feed sentences for the dashboard's latest section
description: Map run feed stages to short operator sentences without shas or internal terms ('v1g merged into the epic, now testing', 'ww2 finished and merged', 'review says not ready: <one line>', 'paused: needs you'), dropping pure mechanics (pushed, push_queued, policy_stated, cleaned_up) from this section. Raw events stay on the [e] view unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: a mapping for every stage the feed emits (a test fails when a new stage has none); mechanics filtered; make gate
